style_name: Watch product render on transparent background
description: Clean studio product photography/render style for a wristwatch, centered and isolated on a transparent or pure black background, with crisp edges, symmetrical front-facing composition, soft controlled reflections, and high-detail material texture. If a brand name or logo appears on the dial, remove it completely.

lighting.highlights: soft linear highlights on case, bracelet, crystal, and strap

materials_rendering.metal: accurate brushed or polished metal texture when applicable
materials_rendering.dial: rich dial texture with preserved fine pattern detail, with any visible brand text or logo removed entirely
materials_rendering.strap: accurate material detail for bracelet, leather, rubber, fabric, or other strap types

post_processing.branding_treatment: remove any visible brand name or logo from the watch entirely

prompt_template: A wristwatch photographed in a clean studio product style, straight-on front view, perfectly centered and symmetrical, isolated on a transparent background, soft diffused studio lighting, accurate material textures, subtle reflections, deep sharp focus, high-end commercial retouching, minimal shadow, ultra-clean edges, realistic product render, with any visible brand name or logo on the dial removed completely.
